title: Jeffsville informal settlement, Atteridgeville (map point approximate): nine people shot dead inside a shack, night of 15 Nov
summary: Nine people, six men and three women, were found shot dead inside a four-roomed shack at the Jeffsville informal settlement in Atteridgeville, west of Pretoria, on the morning of Monday 16 November, Gauteng police told t...
story: Nine people, six men and three women, were found shot dead inside a four-roomed shack at the Jeffsville informal settlement in Atteridgeville, west of Pretoria, on the morning of Monday 16 November, Gauteng police told the Mail & Guardian and IOL. Police believe they were shot between 10pm and 11pm on Sunday 15 November. A child who came to ask for money for school found the bodies, Gauteng Police Commissioner Lt-Gen Tommy Mthombeni said. The motive is not known and no arrests had been reported; the Serious and Violent Crimes, Murder and Robbery Unit is investigating. The map point is approximate: the Atteridgeville area point, not the shack.
incident: Sun 15 Nov 2026, between 10pm and 11pm (police, via Mail & Guardian and IOL); found Mon 16 Nov about 6.45am
location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. Jeffsville informal settlement, Atteridgeville, west of Pretoria. Jeffsville is not in Nominatim, so the pin is the Atteridgeville area point (-25.7714, 28.0736). Area level, about 3 km.
